instructions.name: TTSFPLOAD
instructions.title: Load Dst into a vector register
instructions.summary: Read up to 32 values from Dst into one SFPU register, converting from the selected Dst storage format.

args.name: lreg_ind
args.meaning: Destination LReg index. Loads write L0-L7.

args.name: instr_mod0
args.meaning: Transfer format: 0 follows configured format, 1 FP16, 2 BF16, 3 FP32. Integer and partial-word modes have distinct meanings; see the mode constants and ISA reference. This is not the same mode numbering as SFPLOADI.

args.name: sfpu_addr_mode
args.meaning: Raw SFPU address-modifier field, applied after the transfer. It advances SrcA/SrcB/Dst counters, not fidelity. Llama uses 7 with its configured counters. Do not interpret this as a byte increment.

args.name: dest_reg_addr
args.meaning: Dst address immediate plus configured offsets and RWCs. For normal addressing, the effective low 10 bits select four rows (bits 9:2) and even/odd columns (bit 1); bit 0 is unused. Keep reserved upper bits zero.

notes: One vector covers even or odd columns of four consecutive 16-column Dst rows. Lane n reads row (address & ~3) + n//8 and column 2*(n%8), plus the odd-column selection. Lane configuration can block or exchange columns.
An FPU write to the same Dst region needs at least three unrelated Tensix instructions before SFPLOAD. ZEROACC alone does not establish valid values for an SFPU load.

args.meaning: Destination register L0-L7.

instructions.summary: Compute VD = A * B + C independently in each active FP32 lane, with optional sign and indirect-register modifiers.

args.meaning: A register index. For SFPADD use L10, the 1.0 constant; ordinary register indices are four bits despite this eight-bit encoder field.

args.name: lreg_src_b
args.meaning: B register index.

args.name: lreg_src_c
args.meaning: C register index. For SFPMUL use L9, the 0.0 constant.

args.name: lreg_dest
args.meaning: Destination vector register index (VD). Normal arithmetic writes L0-L7. Destinations 12-15 can record instruction templates when backdoor loading is enabled.

args.name: instr_mod1
args.meaning: Blackhole flags: 1 negates A, 2 negates C, 4 takes A index from L7 low four bits, 8 takes destination index from L7. Combine flags with bitwise OR; 0 is ordinary arithmetic.

notes: Blackhole MAD has a two-cycle result latency and usually stalls direct dependencies automatically. Load-macro sequences and some consumers (including SFPIADD, SFPSHFT, SFPSWAP and SFPSHFT2 modes) need explicit spacing. Llama commonly inserts TTSFPNOP.

instructions.title: Integer add or subtract
instructions.summary: Perform 32-bit integer arithmetic on register bit patterns, optionally updating per-lane condition flags.

args.meaning: Signed 12-bit immediate encoded as value & 0xfff, used when modifier bit 0 is set.

args.name: lreg_c
args.meaning: Source vector register index (VC). L0-L7 are writable vectors; higher indices select constants or special registers.

instructions.summary: Shift the old destination left or logically right. This changes bits inside each lane; it does not move data between lanes.

args.meaning: Signed shift amount encoded in 12 bits when modifier 1 is used. Positive shifts left; negative shifts right.
